- Factor *HECM Interest Rate Used to Return Interest*: rate type monthly_adjustable → most recent applied 6.41. Interest returned 6000×6.41/100×8/12 = 256.40.
- Factor *Premium Months Returned*: 8 > 6 → 6. Premium returned 6000×0.50/100×6/12 = 15.00.
